{{Quote|Bearing an experimental shield generator and a shimmering new energy skin, the cannonship ''Squintpipe'' threaded the enemy formation at Immalia, halting the orbital bombardment and sending the surviving ships scurrying for the jump beacon.|Supreme Chancellor Nagratha|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
The '''''Squintpipe''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[cannonship]] in service by [[7811 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] saw action when the [[Signatories of Waymancy]] carried out an [[Bombardment of Immalia|orbital bombardment]] of [[Immalia]] as part of the [[Waymancy Storm]]. The ''Squintpipe'', equipped with an [[energy skin]] and an experimental [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]], proved instrumental in halting the Signatories' [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombardment]].

==Description==
The ''Squintpipe'' was a [[cannonship]] that was equipped with an experimental [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] as well as an [[energy skin]] that was new<ref name="Author's Cut" /> by [[7811 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The cannonship also shared its name with the [[squintpipe process]], a methodology for improving the [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]] used aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] master [[Engineer/Legends|crafter]] [[Lyns Skutroo]] unveiled in the [[7700s BBY]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:Immalia-EGTW.png|thumb|right|300px|In 7811 BBY, the ''Squintpipe'' saw action at Immalia.]]
The ''Squintpipe'' was in service with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by 7811 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> when the conflict known as the [[Waymancy Storm]] broke out between the Republic and the [[Signatories of Waymancy]]. As part of the conflict, the latter carried out an [[Bombardment of Immalia|orbital bombardment]] of the<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Immalia system/Legends|Immalia system]]</ref> celestial body [[Immalia]], where the ''Squintpipe'' then threaded the formation of the Signatories' starships. As a result, the [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombardment]] was ended and the surviving vessels of the Republic's enemy rushed to the nearby [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|hyperspace jump beacon]] to escape the [[Immalia system/Legends|star system]]. At a speech delivered on the [[25th anniversary of Victory in the Waymancy Storm]] in [[7786 BBY]], the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Nagratha]] noted the ''Squintpipe''{{'s}} performance at Immalia as one of the heroic moments of the Waymancy Storm.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Squintpipe'' was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the starship, authored by [[Daniel Wallace]], was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the ''Squintpipe'' was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
